# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young woman who possesses light, curly hair and captivating eyes. She dresses gorgeously and wears sleeves with a degree of puffiness that exceeds anyone else in Brierley.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

She is an intelligent, gentle, and compassionate teacher who is loved by her students. She possesses a refined manner of speaking and knows how to capture her pupils' interest and bring out their best intellectual and moral qualities. Rather than relying on physical punishment, she manages her classroom through patience and understanding, though she holds her students to high standards of honesty and effort.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011)_

- Intelligent and compassionate  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Goals

- To inspire and bring out the best intellectual and moral qualities in her students  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To guide her advanced students to succeed in the Regent's Entrance Examination  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P18](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0018), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired as the new schoolteacher in Brierley, becoming the first female educator employed in the village. Her appointment was initially met with skepticism by some locals, but she quickly earned the devotion of her pupils through her gentle teaching style, bi-weekly recitation afternoons, nature field days, and physical culture exercises. During her tenure, she introduced an advanced class to prepare older students for the Regent's Entrance Examination, giving them extra instruction after school hours. Though she was offered a position at a grade school in her home district, she chose to return to Brierley for a second year out of deep interest in her students, promising to guide them through to the entrance exams. Under her guidance, all of her Entrance class candidates successfully passed their examinations, with two of her pupils, Nell and Hugh, tying for the top score on the island.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P0](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0000), [v1 c22 P3](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0003), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P31](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0031), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040)_
